title: Points of an oriented C¹ submanifold M with T = m[[M]] (m ≠ 0) on an open set G lie in spt T
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U, G, M ⊆ ℝ^P be sets, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), m ∈ ℤ and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n). Assume: G is open and G ⊆ U; m ≠ 0; M is an embedded C¹ n-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 n M); ξ is an orientation of M (IsOrientation n M ξ: ξ is continuous on M, and for every z ∈ M, ξ(z) is a unit orientation of the subspace tangentSpace M z); Hⁿ(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ G (Hⁿ := μHE[n]); and T(ω) = m·∫_M ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n) with tsupport ω ⊆ G. Then M ∩ G ⊆ spt T, where spt T = T.support = U ∖ zeroRegion T (Simon 6.2.11).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U G M : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), IsOpen G → G ⊆ U → m ≠ 0 → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 n M → IsOrientation n M ξ → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ G → μHE[n] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ G → T ω = m * ∫ x in M, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → M ∩ G ⊆ T.support
